title: Solinus
summary: Raleigh names Solinus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Solinus, who raigned in Aegialia and gaue his daughter Helice to Ion; not Solinus who writes that Bethsan was Nysa. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVI, §. VI, sig. 290b–291a
